notablePrerequisites: Master Biomancer has a power of at least four.
description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Crystalline Crawler.
Crystalline Crawler enters the battlefield with at least four +1/+1 counters due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding four mana of any color(s).
Repeat.
